$comment: The lobby: what a guest can see in the weeks before the party. Presentation and costume only, never plot, which is why it is plaintext beside the encoded bible. A beat writes a character as {{C3}} and the name is substituted when it is served, so no character name is ever written down here. This pack carries copy but no beats or costume notes; the lobby simply shows less.

copy.title: Before the private view
copy.standfirst: You are cast. Here is who the room thinks you are. Everything private to you opens when the doors do.
copy.doorsNote: Your dossier and everything you are carrying into that room unlock on the night. Not before, not for anyone.
